content: This document provides detailed information about the medication rolapitant, commonly known by the brand name Varubi. Rolapitant is used in combination with other medications to prevent delayed nausea and vomiting caused by chemotherapy treatments for cancer. It is typically taken by mouth, with or without food, as directed by a doctor, usually within two hours before receiving chemotherapy. Side Effects: Common side effects of rolapitant may include stomach upset or mouth sores. It is important to note that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of potential side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. However, this is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. If you experience any unusual or severe symptoms, contact your doctor immediately. In the United States, you can report side effects to the FDA, and in Canada, you can report them to Health Canada. Precautions: Before using rolapitant, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other problems. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly needed, as its effects on an unborn child are not fully known. It is also unclear if this drug passes into breast milk, so consult your doctor before breastfeeding. Drug Interactions: Rolapitant can slow the removal of other medications from your body, potentially affecting how they work. This effect may last for four weeks or longer after your dose of rolapitant. Additionally, other medications can influence how rolapitant is removed from your body, which may impact its effectiveness. To minimize the risk of interactions, keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs, as well as herbal products, and share this list with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: In the event of an overdose, if the individual has serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call the Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222. Missed Dose: It is crucial to take each dose of this medication as scheduled. If you miss a dose, contact your healthcare provider for guidance. Storage: Store rolapitant at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Consult your pharmacist or local waste disposal company for safe disposal methods. Important Information: This document is a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. It is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. The information in this document was last revised in May 2024.
